title: The Atlas of Nagasaki's harbor
author: Marguerite Ravensworth
blurb: Rosalind Amberdale, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, keeps a low profile and busy hands. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
